खच् {vI.v} {c1c} {c9c} P. (खचति, खच्नाति,
खचित)
1 To come forth, appear.
--2 To
be born again.
--3 To purify. {vII.v}
{c10c} U. (खचयति, खचित)
1 To fasten,
bind.
--2 To set, inlay.

खचित p. p. [खच्-क्त]
1 Fastened,
joined, full of, intermixed with;
शकुंतनीडखचितं विभ्रज्जटामंडलं Ś. 7. 11.
--2 Mixed, blended.
--3 Inlaid, set,
studded, in comp.; मणि˚, रत्न˚;
